behavior: A later eligible persisted native posting can replace unusable evidence on an otherwise unchanged parked company-discovery request. Candidate/job refresh, audit and one high-priority queue admission are atomic and preserve source/profile authority. PostgreSQL job-lock contention defers enrichment without creating a new job/request foreign-key lock cycle.

verification.environment: Isolated Windows venv, SQLAlchemy2.1.1/psycopg3.3.6, synthetic httpx transports and disposable SQLite files; PostgreSQL16 in an owned loopback-only disposable container, run-specific database and per-test UUID schemas. No production database or real employer request.
verification.command: MJOBS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<owned disposable PostgreSQL URL> python -m pytest -q tests/integration/test_discovery_request_candidate_refresh.py tests/integration/test_discovery_request_candidate_refresh_postgres.py tests/integration/test_discovery_requests.py tests/integration/test_discovery_request_api.py tests/integration/test_official_domain_acquisition.py tests/unit/test_official_domain_acquisition.py tests/integration/test_company_discovery_policy.py --junitxml=docs/evidence/2026-11-03-webpro-89c21f-candidate-refresh/source-tests.xml --tb=short

junit.note: 77 passing cases plus69 successful subtests; not an additional total. Hostname removed.

cases: Real synthetic source collection persists later eligible native evidence, queues one HIGH operation, rejects stale approval and survives Store reopen/replay.
Absent/different incoming profile, changed saved profile, invalid ATS origin, disabled source, altered observation and selected-candidate drift do not refresh.
Dismissed, authorized, queued, running, completed, blocked, cancelled and dead-lettered work preserves its original evidence.
Queue failure rolls back candidate/job replacement and refresh audit.

Disposable PostgreSQL verifies reopen, rollback, two concurrent intakes with one operation/audit, and actual canonical-job FOR UPDATE contention with prompt refresh deferral followed by single admission.

preserved_failures.detail: An artificial datetime.min polling clock overflowed during source backoff. The fixture now uses max(current UTC,due time+one second) before the actual regression was recorded.
The later candidate had admissible native proof, but the existing request remained NEEDS_ORIGIN_REVIEW instead of QUEUED.
Profile versions are strings, and public profile PUT requires the supported input profile shape rather than an expanded API readback. Corrected before final source execution.

preserved_failures.result: 76 tests and69 subtests PASS, then review-found defect
preserved_failures.detail: Initial green suite lacked conflicting collector-job lock coverage and was insufficient for release.

preserved_failures.phase: Independent lock-order review and real PostgreSQL probe
preserved_failures.detail: Collector held canonical_jobs FOR UPDATE while awaiting request; competing intake held request while changed trigger_job_id FK awaited canonical-job FOR KEY SHARE. This candidate was not published or deployed.
Refresh-only FOR KEY SHARE SKIP LOCKED defers when a collector holds the job. New real-lock regression plus the complete adjacent77-case suite passed at c8bf39e7652e68bf1965ad2bd8ad0c9d271ee277.

limitations: MJ-REQ-264 remains PARTIAL: general origin discovery, other native providers and resnapshotting across changed profile revisions remain outside this slice.
Contention defers until an eligible later intake; this is not a universal database deadline or a guarantee of progress under sustained contention.
The candidate only authorizes existing bounded corroboration. It grants no verified domain and performs no employer egress during intake.
The PostgreSQL regression uses real conflicting row locks and real intake transactions, not a full concurrent collector process.
No migration, paid API, live employer submission, credential change or non-idempotent replay.
Protected candidate checks, actual merge and guarded deployment remain pending at this source checkpoint.
